name: The sea & coast
description: The tides, the shore, and the quiet the ocean leaves behind.
sentences: There is something steadying about watching the waves arrive one after another.
Each wave is a little different, yet the pattern never truly breaks.
The sound of water folds the noise of the day into something quiet.
People travel great distances just to sit on a beach and do almost nothing.
Perhaps we need these empty hours more than we like to admit.
A long walk along the shore can loosen a knot that hard thinking could not.
When the tide pulls back it leaves behind small treasures on the sand.
A smooth stone or a curl of shell is worth little, and we gather it anyway.
The sea keeps no calendar and answers to no schedule of ours.
Standing before it, we see that most of our hurry is our own invention.
By evening the light turns gold and then a deep rose over the water.
The horizon seems to hold its breath before letting the sun slip away.
Fishermen coil their ropes with the ease of very long habit.
Salt air has a way of making people honest and a little sleepy.
Children chase the last of the daylight until someone calls them in.
A small fire on the sand can draw strangers into a single warm circle.
The ocean is never quite the same twice, and never entirely different either.
Even on a grey day the sea has more moods than most people show in a year.
There is comfort in a force so large that it makes our worries look small.
We carry these evenings with us long after the sand is gone from our shoes.
